data.title: The wordmark is set in Fraunces, not in mono
data.why: The mark carries the identity; the word only has to sit beside it. A serif word next to a repeat sign reads as a score, matches the H1 already used on the site, and is the one thing that will not be confused with Kadence WP. A monospace wordmark is rejected concept C under another name — the category already wears it.
data.rejected: JetBrains Mono wordmark, kept as lockup-mono.svg for terminal-adjacent surfaces
